verification_methodology_note: This track uses a DISTINCT verification tier from this corpus's primary MOJ-portal method (this law is a Council-of-Ministers/Bureau-of-Experts instrument, not a MOJ-issued one, and is absent from the MOJ legal portal), but is MEANINGFULLY STRONGER than the Anti-Bribery Law track's secondary-source-convergence-only tier: the PRIMARY source here is a genuine official government structured database — the Bureau of Experts (هيئة الخبراء بمجلس الوزراء) legal portal at laws.boe.gov.sa, LawDetails GUID 16b97fcb-4833-4f66-8531-a9a700f161b6 — reached via the WebFetch tool using an https://r.jina.ai/<url> reader-proxy prefix (direct sandbox network access to laws.boe.gov.sa is blocked; this proxy routes the fetch through Anthropic's own infrastructure instead). The extraction is COMPLETE and GAPLESS: all 83 articles across all 9 chapters (باب), in order, no missing articles. The SECOND source is WIPO Lex (World Intellectual Property Organization's official national-legislation database), entry SA016, https://wipolex-res.wipo.int/edocs/lexdocs/laws/ar/sa/sa016ar.pdf — a scanned, nationally-stamped (الهيئة الوطنية للوثائق والمحفوظات / National Center for Archives and Records) government-submitted document using a different, older production pipeline than the BOE database, making it a genuinely independent source rather than a mirror. This PDF has no usable extractable text layer (legacy custom Arabic font encoding); it was rendered to page images (29 pages) and OCR'd with tesseract-ara. Cross-verification against this second source was an EXTENSIVE SPOT-CHECK, NOT AN EXHAUSTIVE PER-ARTICLE DIFF: approximately 39 of the 83 articles (~47%), spanning all 9 chapters and every chapter boundary, were individually compared and found to match substantively with no wording or meaning divergence (only trivial OCR noise such as ذ/ز glyph confusion). The full document's STRUCTURE (83 articles, 9 chapters, identical order and headings) was confirmed to match between both sources in its entirety. Each article in this track's data is individually tagged with cross_verified_against_wipo_lex (true for the ~39 spot-checked articles, false for the remainder, which rest on the complete BOE primary-source extraction plus the whole-document structural match only). Two other candidate PDF mirrors (ibtissam.sa, nshr.org.sa) were found in an earlier research pass but determined to be the SAME underlying scan re-hosted twice, not independent sources, and were NOT used for this cross-verification. No amendment history was found or flagged by the BOE source for any article; this track therefore treats all 83 articles as اصلية (original), consistent with what the primary source itself presented as the current, in-force (ساري) text — no separate amendment-tracking endpoint (equivalent to the MOJ portal's get-Section-Changes) was found to exist on the BOE portal for this instrument.
